info.description:
REST API documentation for the Passion Tree learning platform.
Use the "Authorize" button and paste a valid JWT (without the "Bearer " prefix) to call protected endpoints.
info.title: Passion Tree Backend API

get.summary: List albums for the authenticated user

get.description: Returns a simple admin dashboard greeting (admin only).
Returns platform-wide stats: total users, paths, enrollments, recent activity, etc.
Returns teacher applications filtered by status. Defaults to pending.

put.description: Approves or rejects the specified teacher application.

get.description: Returns every user in the system. Requires admin role.

post.description: Allows an admin to create a user account directly, optionally specifying the role.

put.description: Lets an admin update a user's first name, last name, and role.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the specified user. Irreversible.

put.description: Updates the password for the JWT-authenticated user after verifying the old password.

401.description: Wrong old password or invalid session

post.description: Called after a social login returns a link-confirmation requirement. If `confirm=true`, the social identity is linked to the existing local account.
post.summary: Confirm or decline OAuth account linking

post.description: Marks the account as deactivated for the configured grace period and revokes all active refresh sessions.
post.summary: Temporarily deactivate the authenticated user's account

get.description: Returns a Discord authorization URL the client should redirect to.
Exchanges the OAuth code for tokens and either logs the user in or returns a link-confirmation payload.
Discord redirects here with ?code=...; this endpoint serves an HTML page that immediately redirects to the mobile app's custom URL scheme so flutter_web_auth_2 can capture the code.

post.description: Always returns 200 to avoid leaking whether an email exists in the system.

parameters.description: Email to send reset code to
parameters.name: body

get.description:
Returns a Google authorization URL the client should redirect to.
Sets a CSRF state cookie that must be echoed back on callback.
Exchanges the OAuth code for tokens and either logs the user in or returns a link-confirmation payload if the email already maps to another account.

post.description:
Logs in with username/email + password and returns access & refresh tokens.
May also return `requires_otp` or `requires_reactivation` flags instead of tokens.

parameters.description: Set to 'true' to confirm reactivation of a deactivated account
parameters.name: confirm_reactivate

post.description:
If a refresh_token is provided in the body, only that session is revoked.
Otherwise all refresh tokens for the user are revoked.

parameters.name: body

post.description: Exchanges a Discord OAuth code captured by the mobile client for access & refresh tokens.
Verifies a Google ID token coming from a mobile client and returns access & refresh tokens.
